reviews.title: Like and old friend died
reviews.text: Why doesn’t this application work any longer? More than one iOS and iPadOS release has occurred one this application was last updated. I hope these issues are as simple as aligning the build with the OS because I used to use this application all the time but circumstance hasn’t required me to do so for a while but now I need it more than ever. When the cause arose I knew where to go but sadly it has been like knocking on old friends front door with no answer only to lear they passed away a few years back and nobody cared enough to inform anyone. Mostly, I am baffled that I had the pro version and I am still  using the exact same Apple/iCloud account and now I do not have it anymore, I can’t load ads to view them anymore to regain my Pro version without having to pay again and frankly I shouldn’t have to watch the ads again anyway. Now I also see it has been three years since this once excellent app was updated. Maybe the developer friends have knocked on their door too and in which case I will retract this review, I would even take over development on their behalf if it helps. Not often an application stimulates such emotion but this was really good, it was useful and fairly priced with the option to watch adds for those with less means. The application deserves five stars but only if it is actively taken care of or an explanation is provided. reviews.title: Be careful
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and a day later, was charged £29.90. I cannot afford to lose this amount of money. I wasn’t aware of there being any subscription involved and can’t recall anything telling me there was. Now I don’t know what to do; I can’t afford any more charges. 😫
